primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: ヘマンの子らの列挙でウジエルを名指す。
primaryTextRead.text: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 歴代誌上25:5にウジエルの名が記される。
primaryTextRead.text: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 歴代誌上25:6にウジエルの名が記される。
primaryTextRead.text: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB 1CH25:18は「Azarel」と記し、候補ID Uzzielとは異なる。綴り対応や同一人物を示す根拠がないため保留。
primaryTextRead.text: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

wikipediaRead.title: 1 Chronicles 25
wikipediaRead.locator: L168–185. Table row at L183 says the 11th division is Azareel and notes “Uzziel in 1 Chronicles 25:4”; chapter introduction L135–140 discusses the chapter’s musician organization. The profile note uses only the 25:4 roster, not the later equation.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事は25章の楽人名簿を扱い、25:4のウジエルをヘマンの名簿に置く。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 章内文脈は適合。記事は後のアザレル表記と関連付けるが、その同一性・役割は25:18以前に読者向け欄へ出さず、本文事実の事実gateに限る。
wikipediaRead.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, “1 Chronicles 25,” CC BY-SA 4.0; accessed 2026-10-16T10:29:11Z.

sourceReuse: All pinned WEB passages and any linked article body checked for this 1CH identity; no prior profile text copied.
